context.objective: Document how we carry out Carry Vesting & Carry Point Reallocation, the controls and what needs confirmation.

turns.text: Thanks for sharing. Give me a moment to digest the file. Then I’ll follow up with a question.

The document says a supported departure or another vesting or point-allocation change starts the work, and the preparer opens a carry-change record. How does that event reach the preparer in practice?

It reaches me as the change package from the upstream GP-02 process, or as a supported event notice. That package gives me the member's identity, the supported status and effective date, and the change or separation records, and that is what I open the carry change from. It is in the document I uploaded, on the page with Step 1. I can't point you to a more specific channel than that.
Once you open the carry change, how do you confirm which governing vesting terms apply?

That is Step 2 in the document I uploaded. I work from the current GPLPA or LPA, including amendments, together with the change or separation record and any approved exception. I identify the standard provision and every approved exception, and I record the governing vested percentage and its scope. What I keep is a final governing-source record that is protected from changes. If the terms, a special permission or the effective date are missing, unclear or conflicting, I stop and get a current written interpretation from the adviser or the client, and I never use a default percentage.
How do you confirm the original points and prior carry agree across the schedules, workbooks, distributions, and accounting records?

That is Step 3 and the prior carry reconciliation check in my document. I check the original points on the current client-approved schedule against the prior workbook and the full member list. Then I confirm the prior allocations, distributions and recorded amounts from the start through the current period against the accounting records and the prior workbooks, and that the carry calculation base agrees as well. I keep that as a carry rollforward, meaning opening balance, changes and ending balance, and the Reviewer reviews it before I calculate any points. No unexplained difference is allowed. If something does not agree I stop, the Reviewer resolves the starting difference, and the calculation and downstream use stay blocked until there is proof the starting amounts agree.
How do you obtain and document the client’s method choice and named recipients?

That is Step 4 in my document. Both come as a written client instruction, and the client can only choose a method the governing terms allow. I record the method, the effective date and the named recipients in the decision record, which stays with the change package as the final approved version protected from changes. If the client picks the cumulative true-up, Method B, I apply the hold and keep a hold record instead. I don't know the approved template for the decision record or where it is meant to be stored. That has not been confirmed, and Operations, Technology and Records Management would be the ones to confirm it.
Once the governing vested percentage and original points are confirmed, how do you calculate and independently check the vested and released points?

That is Step 5 and the point calculation rule in my document. Vested points are the original approved points times the governing vested percentage, and released points are the original points minus the vested points. I allocate all of the released points to the named recipients and confirm that all member point changes total zero. The Reviewer independently recalculates it and the client confirms the recipients, and if it does not work out we stop and correct it. I don't know the rounding convention for points, because none has been set. Until Accounting policy or process governance confirm one, we use exact amounts and allow no unexplained differences.
After the point calculation is reviewed, how do you build and check the dated schedules before they are used?
This capture still has open sections. 16 of 16 are open; the Notes list shows which. You can create a partial draft.

topics.answer: The procedure names the work Carry Vesting & Carry Point Reallocation, process GP-03.
The documented result is supported vesting and recipient reallocation, complete effective-date schedules, and an authorized carry calculation through the current period.

The procedure starts on a supported member departure or another event changing vesting or point allocation; it also calls for schedule confirmation before each allocation cycle.
The participant opens the carry change from a GP-02 change package or supported event notice. The package supplies member identity, supported status and effective date, and change or separation records.
The contractual deadline and deadline for late changes are not established in the procedure.
The participant cannot identify a more specific delivery channel for the change package or notice.

Documented completion requires supported terms and original points, independent point recalculation and zero-sum changes, complete dated schedules, an executable cumulative calculation less prior recorded amounts, agreement of final schedules and entry with downstream outputs, and retained approval and review support. A requested Method B remains on hold unless its documented gap is closed.
The documented process owner, internal approval and release authority, and authority to correct or reissue outputs are unconfirmed.

The participant uses the current GPLPA or LPA including amendments, the change or separation record and approved exceptions to identify the standard provision and each exception, recording the governing vested percentage and scope in a final record protected from changes.
If terms, special permission or effective date are missing, unclear or conflicting, the participant stops and obtains a current written interpretation from the adviser or client rather than using a default percentage.
The procedure has the preparer reconcile original points, schedules, cumulative allocations and distributions, recorded amounts and the carry calculation base across prior records before the client chooses a permitted method and recipients, which the preparer documents.
The procedure calls for vested and released points to be calculated, all released points allocated to named recipients and member point changes checked to total zero. If starting records disagree or recipients are not exact and named, calculation and downstream use stop until corrected.
With approved points and date, the documented preparer retains the prior schedule, creates a dated new schedule including approved deal or tranche details, and checks period coverage and totals. For a go-forward method, earlier amounts remain unchanged and the new schedule applies from the approved date; cumulative carry less prior recorded amounts produces the current-period entry.
The document holds Method B execution until its formula, accounting treatment, release criteria, testing, owner and approvals are documented; an authorized go-forward method may still be used.
The documented reviewer reviews governing support, calculations, schedules, cumulative carry, accounting entry and outputs when the package is complete and no blocking hold remains; final schedules are protected and supporting records retained.
For a missing or overlapping schedule period, wrong total or member list, the procedure stops affected carry calculations, corrects the full schedule set, obtains approval again and recalculates affected periods and outputs. For a change after submission or release, unreleased output is stopped pending a correction or reissue decision, renewed checks and approval.
The participant checks original points on the current client-approved schedule against the prior workbook and full member list, and confirms prior allocations, distributions, recorded amounts and the carry calculation base against accounting records and prior workbooks through the current period.
The participant receives the method and named recipients in a written client instruction, records the method, effective date and recipients in the protected final approved decision record with the change package, and applies a hold and keeps a hold record if Method B is selected.
The participant calculates vested points as original approved points multiplied by the governing vested percentage, and released points as original points less vested points. The participant allocates all released points to named recipients and confirms that all member point changes total zero.

The procedure assigns independent source, point, schedule, cumulative carry, prior-booking and output checks to the GPFS reviewer. The client confirms the permitted method, effective date, special permission and recipients and approves schedules.
Documented checks compare original points and prior carry records without unexplained differences, independently recalculate vested and released points, and verify recipient increases equal released points. Dated schedules must match approved members and totals without missing or overlapping periods.
The procedure leaves the formal schedule-coverage test, point rounding, action threshold and error-correction standards open.
Until formal standards are confirmed, the procedure calls for exact amounts and no unexplained differences.
The participant keeps a carry rollforward of opening balance, changes and ending balance for Reviewer review before point calculation. If starting amounts disagree, work stops; the Reviewer resolves the difference and calculation and downstream use remain blocked until proof of agreement.
The Reviewer independently recalculates the point calculation and the client confirms recipients. If it does not work out, the participant says work stops and is corrected.

The document describes a go-forward route applying revised points from the approved effective date, and a deal or tranche route requiring approved deal or tranche details and more detailed schedules and comparisons. Method B is a concept on execution hold, not an approved executable alternative.

The procedure identifies risks of wrong workbook versions or formula ranges, dependence on one person, misallocation across periods, and difficulty tracing or retrieving records where ownership and storage are unconfirmed.

The participant uses the current GPLPA or LPA and amendments, change or separation record and approved exceptions, and keeps a protected final governing-source record.
The procedure identifies a decision record for event details, governing support, method, recipients and reason; a carry schedule workbook; prior carry reconciliation; dated schedules; and cumulative calculation and entry support.
The participant does not know the approved decision-record template or its storage location; Operations, Technology and Records Management would confirm them. Other record locations and retention periods are also unconfirmed in the procedure.
The participant keeps a carry rollforward showing opening balance, changes and ending balance for the Reviewer's review.
Written client instructions supply the method and named recipients. The participant retains the protected final approved decision record with the change package, or a hold record when Method B is selected.

The documented scope includes vesting, released-point reallocation, effective schedules and executable carry calculation. It excludes capital commitment treatment, the underlying waterfall or clawback, legal interpretation, and Method B execution until its blocking gap is closed.

The procedure gives current governing documents and approved exceptions priority over client examples, workbooks, prior practice and employee knowledge. The participant stops for written interpretation when terms, permission or dates are unclear and does not default the percentage.
The documented formulas are original approved points multiplied by governing vested percentage for vested points, and original less vested points for released points. Released points go to named recipients and all member changes total zero.
The document says carry is calculated from inception through the current period under each applicable schedule; the current-period entry is cumulative calculated carry less carry already recorded. Under a go-forward method, already recorded or distributed carry is not changed.
The participant says the client may select only a method permitted by the governing terms; a Method B selection is held.
The participant says no point-rounding convention has been set. Until Accounting policy or process governance confirms one, exact amounts are used and no unexplained differences are allowed.

The participant receives the change package from upstream GP-02. The procedure also identifies GP-04 as providing approved carry entitlement and calculation base, and GP-01 and GP-06 as downstream users of final approved schedules and the current-period entry.

The procedure describes Excel and Word schedules and formulas as calculation tools and supporting records, not governing sources, and calls for independent review of each version and formula range. It says no official carry workbook is approved.
The documented approved carry calculation source, exact accounts and entries, posting path and downstream release records remain unconfirmed; accounting and release steps are entity- or client-specific.

steps.description: The participant calculates vested points as original approved points multiplied by the governing vested percentage, and released points as original points less vested points. They allocate all released points to named recipients and check that all member point changes total zero. The Reviewer independently recalculates, and the client confirms the recipients.

steps.title: Stop and correct point errors
steps.description: The participant says the team stops and corrects the calculation if it does not work out. Individual correction ownership and the return for checking are UNKNOWN.

steps.title: Build effective schedules
steps.description: Keep the prior schedule, create a dated new version, include approved deal or tranche details where applicable, and check periods, member lists and totals.

steps.title: Correct and reapprove schedules
steps.description: For missing or overlapping periods, wrong totals or wrong member lists, stop the affected calculation, correct the full schedule set and obtain approval again. Recalculate affected periods and outputs.

steps.title: Calculate carry and entry
steps.description: For an executable go-forward method, retain earlier amounts and apply revised points from the approved date. Calculate carry from inception through the current period under applicable schedules and subtract prior recorded amounts to prepare the current-period entry.

steps.title: Resolve cumulative carry differences
steps.description: The procedure requires work to stop and differences in the cumulative calculation or subtraction of prior recorded amounts to be resolved. Ownership and resumption point are UNKNOWN.

steps.title: Independently review package
steps.description: Independently repeat source, point, schedule, cumulative carry, prior-booking and output checks. Independently review every version and each range of cells used in formulas. The complete package must have no blocking hold; review comments must be resolved and outputs must agree before release.

steps.title: Protect and publish outputs
steps.actor: Preparer and Reviewer; release role UNKNOWN
steps.description: The procedure directs protection of final schedules, updates to GP-01 and GP-06, and retention of supporting records. The client approves schedules. Its final-output check requires agreement of the schedules, entry and downstream outputs, resolution of review comments, and confirmation that all users receive the final schedule. The release role and posting path are unconfirmed.

steps.title: Handle late reported changes
steps.description: If a change is reported after workbook submission or output release, stop unreleased output, obtain a correction or reissue decision, rerun checks and obtain approval again. GP-01 or GP-06 may need reissue; the decision authority is unconfirmed.

steps.title: Confirm schedules before allocation
steps.description: The procedure calls for schedules to be confirmed again before each allocation cycle. The detailed handoff into that cycle is UNKNOWN.

steps.title: Review carry rollforward
steps.description: The Reviewer reviews the carry rollforward before the participant calculates points. The exact review evidence and handoff mechanism are UNKNOWN.
